authority.reason: Tetrp is the reverse-engineered deterministic match authority. Gravity is neutralized so placement speed does not influence strategy; frame timing remains active for garbage semantics.

synchronous_protocol.decision_barrier: both visible snapshots and both choices are produced before either placement is committed
synchronous_protocol.slot_swap_reason: Canonical tetrp-authority run 35427392644 verified deterministic slot symmetry; swapping the same seed duplicates the same profile trajectories.

screen.design: Each of the eight seeds is replayed at all three equal-player paces. Pace blocks are repeated-measures robustness probes, not 24 fully independent seed observations.
screen.safety_cap_policy: Exceeding the safety cap is a harness failure and is not scored.

interpretation.purpose: Directional transfer screen only. Determine whether the legacy-arena tuned package shows a robust useful direction under the synchronous Tetrp authority before expensive confirmation or feature archaeology.
report: candidate/baseline KO wins separately at each pace
per-seed outcomes across all three paces
match-length and APP diagnostics without using them as tiebreakers
interpretation.no_pooled_significance: Do not compute a naive 24-match binomial p-value because each seed appears in three pace conditions.
interpretation.next_if_consistent_positive: Use fresh seeds for a larger new-authority confirmation, then decompose H1/H2/H6C/H9.
interpretation.next_if_mixed: Investigate pace interaction and state-model mismatch before feature ablation.
interpretation.next_if_negative: Do not resurrect the old lineage by inertia; use corrected legacy/new-authority evidence as the new starting point.
interpretation.observed: The tuned H1+H2+H6C+H9+H12 package transferred strongly in direction under the synchronous Tetrp authority: 7-1 at 2 PPS, 6-2 at 2.5 PPS, and 8-0 at 3 PPS.
interpretation.caution: This remains a directional screen on only eight unique seeds repeated across three pace conditions. Do not treat 21-3 as 24 independent trials.
interpretation.pace_note: 3 PPS produced much longer matches in piece count (average 783.625 lock steps) than 2/2.5 PPS. This may be a real consequence of the 20-frame garbage-travel boundary, but should be treated as a protocol behavior worth preserving and checking rather than silently averaging away.
interpretation.next: Run a larger confirmation on fresh seeds before feature ablation. Use one primary pace plus smaller robustness blocks at the other paces, then ablate H1/H2/H6C/H9 only if the fresh-seed confirmation remains positive.

invalidated_runs.reason: 3 PPS batches hit an artificial placement-transport limit because each synthetic soft-drop row consumed one whole source frame. This is a harness transport bug, not a scored strategy loss. Partial outcomes from this run are not used.

transport_fix.semantics: Pack down/shift/rotation/hold as legal Tetrp subframe taps while preserving the scheduled hard-drop lock frame. PPS continues to control authority time, not artificial path reachability.
